evidence_required: field list, volume estimate with arithmetic, alert rules, and a defence paragraph

marking.criterion: Field list: CUDA-event phases, entry skew, tokens, clocks/reasons/temp/power, NIC throughput and retransmissions, map keys
Sampling interval (every 10-50 steps per rank plus DCGM 1 Hz) and skew measured without synchronized clocks
Volume estimate with consistent arithmetic (e.g. 4,096 x 20 x 8 B x 4,320 samples = 2.8 GB/day)
Alert rules with thresholds and statistics (robust z ≥ 6 in ≥ 25 % of a window, wait fraction > 10 %, rail-grouped retransmission ratio)

title: Straggler telemetry for ORION-XL
